Lemon drizzle cake
Serves 8. Oven 180°C / 160°C fan / gas 4
225g unsalted butter, softened
225g caster sugar
4 eggs
225g self-raising flour
Zest of 1 lemon
For the drizzle: juice of 1 1/2 lemons and 85g caster sugar
Bake in a 2lb loaf tin for 45-50 minutes. Pour the drizzle over while the cake is still warm.

Grandma's pancakes
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
3 1/2 tsp baking powder
1 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups milk
1 egg
3 tbsp melted butter
Mix the dry ingredients, then whisk in the rest. Cook 1/4 cup at a time on a hot griddle, about 2 minutes per side. Makes 8.

Tomato soup
Prep 10 min, cook 35 min, serves 4
1 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, chopped
2 garlic cloves, crushed
2 x 400g tins chopped tomatoes
500ml vegetable stock
1 tsp sugar
Soften the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes, stock and sugar. Simmer for 25 minutes and blend until smooth.

Chocolate chip cookies
Preheat oven to 375°F.
2 1/4 cups flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp salt
1 cup butter, 3/4 cup sugar, 3/4 cup brown sugar
2 eggs, 2 tsp vanilla
2 cups chocolate chips
Bake 9 to 11 minutes until golden. Cool on the sheet for 2 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

Overnight oats
50g rolled oats
150ml milk or oat drink
2 tbsp natural yoghurt
1 tsp chia seeds
1 tsp honey
Stir everything together in a jar, cover and chill for at least 6 hours. Top with berries in the morning. 312 kcal per serving.

Chicken curry (serves 4)
600g chicken thighs, diced
2 onions, sliced
3 tbsp curry paste
400ml coconut milk
200g spinach
Brown the chicken in batches. Fry the onions for 10 minutes, stir in the paste for 2 minutes, then return the chicken and add the coconut milk. Simmer for 20 minutes and wilt in the spinach.
Freezes for up to 3 months.

Banana bread
3 ripe bananas, mashed
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg, beaten
1 tsp vanilla
1 tsp baking soda
Pinch of salt
1 1/2 cups flour
Bake at 350°F in a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan for 55 to 60 minutes.

Scones
350g self-raising flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder
85g butter, cubed
3 tbsp caster sugar
175ml milk
1 tsp vanilla extract, squeeze of lemon juice
Rub the butter into the flour until it looks like fine crumbs. Add the sugar, then the warm milk, and bring together. Cut into 8 rounds with a 5cm cutter.
Bake at 220°C / 200°C fan for 10 minutes.

Vinaigrette
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1/2 tsp honey
Salt and pepper
Shake in a jar until combined. Keeps in the fridge for 1 week.

Guacamole
2 ripe avocados
1/2 small red onion, finely diced
1 jalapeño, seeded and minced
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
Juice of 1 lime
1/2 tsp kosher salt
Mash the avocados with a fork and fold in the rest. Serve within 2 hours. Serves 4 as a dip.

Shortbread
125g butter
55g caster sugar, plus extra to finish
180g plain flour
Beat the butter and sugar together until smooth. Stir in the flour to get a smooth paste. Roll out to 1cm thick and cut into 12 fingers.
Chill for 20 minutes, then bake at 190°C / gas 5 for 15-20 minutes until pale golden.

Roast vegetables
Oven 200°C / 180°C fan
2 red peppers, 1 courgette, 1 red onion, 300g butternut squash
3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried thyme
Cut everything into 3cm chunks, toss with the oil and thyme, and roast for 35-40 minutes, turning halfway. Serves 4, 180 kcal each.
